meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 当用户要求重构代码时,Claude 不会直接改,而是先做意图确认、并行分析代码与依赖,构建代码地图并评估测试覆盖,再制定分步计划,逐步修改并在每步后运行测试与类型检查,最后跑完整测试并汇总改动。
howto.when: 当用户提到 'refactor'、'cleanup'、'restructure' 等触发词时触发。目标、范围或期望结果不明确时,Claude 会先提问确认。

say.text: 把 src/auth/handler.ts 重构一下,拆成更小的模块
say.note: 会先分析依赖与测试,再分步修改

say.text: 清理项目里所有使用旧版 API 的函数
say.note: 先定位受影响代码,再逐一替换

say.text: 提取这段校验逻辑到独立模块,保持行为不变
say.note: 先出计划,每步测试通过才继续

howto.what_en: When asked to refactor, Claude confirms intent, analyzes code/dependencies, maps impact, checks test coverage, then plans and applies changes step by step, running tests/type checks after each step, then the full suite, and summarizes.
howto.when_en: When the user mentions triggers like 'refactor', 'cleanup', or 'restructure'. If the target, scope, or expected outcome is unclear, Claude asks clarifying questions first.

say_en.note: Analyzes dependencies/tests first, then edits step by step.

say_en.text: Clean up all functions using the deprecated API in this project.
say_en.note: It locates impact zones, then replaces them one by one.

say_en.text: Extract this validation logic into a separate module, behavior unchanged.
say_en.note: Plans first; proceeds only when tests pass after each step.
